body.name: \(\boldsymbol G_{m,n}\)
body.construction: Let \(\delta_{\beta,n}=e_{y,n}-E_{Y,n}\beta_n\), \(\delta_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}=e_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}-E_{Z,\mathrm{dir},n}a_{n,\ell}\), and \(\delta_{\mathrm{rec},n}=e_{\mathrm{rec},n}-E_{Z,\mathrm{rec},n}a_n\). Define \(G_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}=a_{n,\ell}^{\top}E_{W,n}^{\top}\beta_n+p_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}^{\top}\delta_{\beta,n}+q_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}^{\top}\delta_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}\) and \(G_{\mathrm{rec},n,\ell}=g_{n,\ell}^{\top}E_{W,n}^{\top}\beta_n+p_{\mathrm{rec},n,\ell}^{\top}\delta_{\beta,n}+q_{\mathrm{rec},n,\ell}^{\top}\delta_{\mathrm{rec},n}\), then stack over \(1\le\ell\le H_n\).
